Foundation Panel 的维护更新，随 Foundation Sunshine 安装包一起提供。
A maintenance update of the Foundation Panel, shipped with the Foundation Sunshine installer.

- 配合支持的 Sunshine 版本，在串流期间应用客户端的触摸键盘偏好，并在会话结束后恢复原设置。
  With a compatible Sunshine version, applies the client's touch keyboard preference during streaming and restores the previous setting afterwards.
- 新增“恢复默认设置”页面，可分别恢复主机设置和 Panel 偏好，并提供确认倒计时。
  Adds a reset page for host settings and Panel preferences, with a confirmation countdown.
- 改进剪贴板连接状态和诊断信息；概览新增显卡驱动故障、安全模式及编码器检测提示。
  Improves clipboard connection status and diagnostics, and adds overview notices for graphics driver failures, safe mode and encoder detection.
- 改进公网地址检测的状态与失败提示，修复检测请求可能长时间无响应的问题。
  Improves public address detection status and failure messages, including a timeout for stalled checks.
- 更新手柄设置的名称与提示，修复画质增强滑块切换时丢失编辑的问题。
  Updates controller setting labels and messages, and fixes lost edits when switching image enhancement sliders.

本发行版的 `sunshine-gui-windows-x64.zip` 供 Foundation Sunshine 打包使用；单独使用请安装 [Foundation Sunshine](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/releases/latest)。
`sunshine-gui-windows-x64.zip` in this release is used by Foundation Sunshine's packaging; to use the panel, install [Foundation Sunshine](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/releases/latest).
